reviews.comment:
Si querés viajar a los años 70´s, éste es el lugar. prácticamente se mantiene igual. Los baños limpios y la cafetería del ACA bien, pero nada para asombrar, las hamburguesas del full market son carísimas y por lo que pagas una allí te compras un combo de Mac Donald's en Chascomús.

(Translated by Google)
If you want to travel back to the 70s, this is the place. It's practically unchanged. The bathrooms are clean and the ACA cafeteria is okay, but nothing amazing. The hamburgers at the Full Market are ridiculously expensive, and for the price of one there you could buy a McDonald's combo meal in Chascomús.
